title: Conversion to a Finite Machine
statement: Let $c$ be an effective machine code and let $\alpha$ be a binary string. The finite machine obtained by converting the $K$-machine associated with $c$ at $\alpha$ is equal to the finite machine obtained by converting the machine decoded from $\alpha$.
replaced:
Let $c$ be an effective machine code and let $\alpha$ be a binary string. The finite
machine obtained by converting the $k$-tape machine associated to $c$ at $\alpha$ is
equal to the finite machine obtained by converting the machine decoded from $\alpha$.
